name: ogg-play-card
description: Builds Ogg's Play card from studio-card/src into one file for Home Assistant.

scripts.build: esbuild studio-card/src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --charset=utf8 --banner:js="/* Ogg Play card, built from studio-card/src (npm run build). Do not edit here. */" --outfile=custom_components/ogg/frontend/oggstudio-card.js && esbuild studio-card/src/guest/index.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --charset=utf8 --banner:js="/* Ogg Together remote, built from studio-card/src/guest (npm run build). Do not edit here. */" --outfile=custom_components/ogg/frontend/together-guest.js
scripts.test: node studio-card/tests/card_logic_test.mjs && node studio-card/tests/tools_test.mjs && node studio-card/tests/patterns_test.mjs && python studio-card/tests/convert_test.py
